# ankra_stack_profile_logo (Resource)

An uploaded logo for a stack profile: a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 512 KiB and 1024x1024 pixels. The counterpart of `ankra stack-profiles logo set` and `ankra stack-profiles logo clear`. Uploading clears the profile's `logo_url`, and setting `logo_url` deletes the upload, so manage one or the other. A logo replaced outside Terraform shows as a change to `content_base64`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_stack_profile_logo" "platform" {
  profile_id     = ankra_stack_profile.platform.id
  content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/logo.png")
  content_type   = "image/png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String) The image, base64-encoded; typically `filebase64("logo.png")`.
- `content_type` (String) `image/png`, `image/jpeg` or `image/webp`; it must match the image.
- `profile_id` (String) Profile the logo belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the uploaded image, hex-encoded.
- `id` (String) The profile ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Logos are imported by the profile ID.
terraform import ankra_stack_profile_logo.platform 7b1d2c3e-4f5a-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
```
